content: The HWPX (Hancom Office) manipulation task was successful using a multi-stage approach: 1) Extracting the HWPX as a ZIP archive. 2) Using namespace-aware XML parsing (specifically the 'hp' namespace) to consolidate text across split `<hp:t>` tags within `<hp:run>` elements. 3) Removing `<hp:lineSegArray>` tags to ensure the HWPX viewer recalculates layout for the new text. 4) Re-zipping the content with the 'mimetype' file stored (not deflated) at the root. This 'consolidate-within-run' pattern is highly effective for Hancom-specific XML where placeholders often get split by formatting markers.
